recent_articles.title: ‘Needless fuss’: Kerala CM V.D. Satheesan defends posting former State poll chief Rathan Kelkar as his Secretary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** stated that the appointment of **Rathan U. Kelkar**, former Chief Electoral Officer (Kerala), as his Secretary was not a cause for concern and dismissed criticisms from the opposition.  He emphasized that no political party in Kerala had accused Mr. Kelkar of election manipulation, noting that he was appointed by the previous CPI(M)-led LDF government. **Mr. Satheesan** further highlighted that Mr. Kelkar's appointment is not comparable to similar controversies in West Bengal where allegations against the CEO were made.

recent_articles.title: Former Kerala Chief Electoral Officer Rathan U. Kelkar takes charge as Secretary to CM Satheesan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rathan U. Kelkar**, former Chief Electoral Officer of Kerala, assumed the role of Secretary to **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan**.  The appointment has been met with criticism from the **CPI(M)** and **BJP**, who accuse the Congress of rewarding officials for election results. However, **Congress** leaders defend the decision, highlighting **Kelkar's** reputation as an efficient officer.

recent_articles.title: Veteran Congress leader Mangalam Gopinath passes away - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mangalam Gopinath**, an 88-year-old veteran Congress leader and socio-cultural activist, passed away on Sunday evening at a hospital in Manjeri after a battle with cancer.  A former member of the **All India Congress Committee** and **Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee**, Gopinath was also known for collecting all election manifestos of the Congress since 1937. His funeral will be held at Vettekkod on Monday at 2 p.m.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan offers Tulabharam at Guruvayur temple - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister V. D. Satheesan** visited the **Guruvayur Sreekrishna Temple** on Sunday morning, offering prayers and performing the traditional Tulabharam ritual using 71 kg of butter. He was received by **devaswom chairperson A. V. Gopinath** and administrator **O. B. Arun Kumar**.  After the ceremony, **Satheesan** attended the wedding ceremony of **Revenue Minister A. P. Anilkumar’s** son.

recent_articles.title: Rural roads in Belagavi to be developed under Pragatipath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Belagavi Zilla Panchayat** will construct 481.14 km of rural roads in the district under the **State government’s Pragatipath scheme**, costing ₹350 crore. The project, funded by a loan from the **Asian Development Bank** and a state share, aims to improve rural connectivity and is being overseen by the **Karnataka Rural Road Development Corporation**.  The first phase of construction will involve 230.54 km at a cost of ₹163 crore.

recent_articles.title: Minister’s assurance on Plus One seats brings relief to north Kerala students - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **General Education Minister N. Samsudheen** has announced that the marginal increase of Plus One seats and additional batches allotted last year will be included in the admissions process, offering relief to North Kerala districts facing severe seat shortages. The state cabinet is scheduled to meet on Monday (May 25, 2026) to approve the rollout of the admissions process.  The previous Left Democratic Front government had allocated additional batches and a marginal increase of seats, but these were announced after the allotment process began last year.

recent_articles.title: Master plan to transform Kochi into model city to come up in six months, says Satheesan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** announced a plan to transform **Kochi** into a model city with seamless transport and world-class infrastructure through a "twin city" expansion.  He emphasized the government's commitment to improving people's quality of life, boosting Kerala's economy, and addressing issues like brain drain.  The Chief Minister also pledged to distribute wealth fairly among all sections of society and prevent communalism. **Actor Mammootty** and **Actor Mohanlal** expressed their support for his vision.

recent_articles.title: Idukki DCC president nominated murder-accused to committee without consultation, say members - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C.P. Mathew**, president of the **Idukki District Congress Committee (DCC)**, has nominated **Nikhil Paily**, the prime suspect in the 2022 murder of SFI activist Dheeraj Rajendran, to the committee. This nomination has sparked outrage among DCC members who claim Mr. Mathew did not consult with other members or the **Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC)** before making the decision.  Many DCC members are now demanding Mr. Mathew's removal from his position as president.

recent_articles.title: Congress asks its rank and file to be alert against deletion of voters ahead of SIR exercise in Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders are concerned about the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise in Karnataka, fearing voter suppression similar to what happened in West Bengal. The party has urged its rank and file to remain vigilant and is preparing for potential challenges. **Randeep Surjewala**, Congress general secretary in charge of Karnataka, emphasized the importance of educating voters about SIR's implications.  The State government is expected to respond to the concerns raised by the party soon.
